name: Google Sapphire
description: A Google-sponsored code-modernization platform that translates legacy code into user-selected stacks and produces runnable tests using an agentic translation pipeline.

name: Paladin
description: A cloud-native receipt vault that uploads receipt images, extracts structured data, and organizes receipts by merchant and date.

name: FrostSight
description: A cloud cost-intelligence platform that ingests billing exports, stores and caches spend data, exposes REST/GraphQL APIs, and renders an interactive cost explorer.

name: CloudGuard Audit Agent

name: Kung Fu Express
description: A TypeScript/React restaurant POS system with FastAPI/PostgreSQL services and LangChain-powered AI ordering workflows.
